title: The first month of a simpler routine
sourceNote: Synthetic OpenDoc example. All figures and activities are illustrative; no real organizational records were used.
summary: The team began recording requests in one shared local register. Twelve assignments were completed during the month. There is not yet enough consistent history to set a useful cycle-time target. The next step is to agree a clear definition of completion and use it for every new assignment.

actions.title: Agree one definition of a completed request.
